alt: A short film with no voice. A staircase room. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands proudly next to a small table, under a banner that reads HUMBLED & THRILLED with a smaller line under it: (it is a Tuesday), while a white door fills the right edge. It stretches taller and pulses with chimes while a navy figure on the right watches with narrowed eyes, then closes its eyes and slowly dozes off standing up. At the end the first figure's eyes narrow too. The text stays: if this found you: nobody is 'humbled and thrilled' by a Tuesday. Log off.
